title: Easy Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps:
Onion + pepper
in butter 5 min,
then garlic + spices

Chicken, beans, corn,
5 more minutes,
squeeze the lime
vo: Grab a rotisserie chicken. Dinner's done in thirty minutes.
You need rotisserie chicken, broth, diced tomatoes, black beans, corn, an onion, a pepper and a lime.
Cook the onion and pepper in butter for five minutes, then add garlic, cumin and chili powder.
Pour in the broth and tomatoes and simmer ten minutes.
Stir in the chicken, beans and corn, simmer five more minutes, then squeeze in the lime. Kids add their own chips and cheese.
